# `armadad etcd`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

etcd runs this server's etcd member with the etcd program of the runtime pack.
systemd starts it as armada-etcd.service on every server machine. It works the
member out as the server does (name, data, addresses, certificate), writes etcd's
configuration file (etcd/etcd.yaml, 0600) beside it, and replaces itself with
etcd. It refuses while another process holds the member. Flags it does not know
(the server's, from ARMADA_SERVER_FLAGS) are ignored.

```
armadad etcd [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
sudo systemctl status armada-etcd                 # started by systemd on server machines
sudo armadad etcd --bin-dir /opt/etcd-v3.7.4       # a build without the runtime pack
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--bin-dir string` | use the etcd program in this directory (builds without the runtime pack) |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
